_about: Settings for the automatic request list (requests_scan.py, checked every 10 minutes by .github/workflows/requests.yml). account: the TikTok account whose video comments are read. phrases: a comment counts as a request when it contains one of these (lowercase, accents ignored; matched as whole words). options: traced before the video (just the video's own: fastest). more_options: traced right after the video is ready, in the same job, so other looks can be picked and rendered from the phone. video: the one rendered ready to post. max_per_run: requests processed per run (about 2 min each). Single words (moi, mine, my, ...) catch any comment pointing at the commenter. Each person is drawn once: later comments from someone already in the list are ignored.
